paragraphs.text: Ghired is a former shaman of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica who later aligned with the Gruul Clans before leaving the plane for Thunder Junction .

Ghired shifted his allegiance after witnessing the awe-inspiring manifestation of the Boar - God Ilharg , during the War of the Spark . Even though he was now Gruul, Ghired maintained a deep love for his animals and his connection to Selesnya magic. He wouldn't hesitate to call on boars and other large creatures to aid in his destructive activities.
Still unsatisfied with the confinements of Ravnica, Ghired traveled through the Omenpaths to Thunder Junction to experience its untamed wilderness.
